messages.author: 2b1ee85f1861546c
messages.subject: Shinydashboard 'subMenuItem' not dynamic
parts:
Hello,

I'm building a dashboard using shinydashboard and am noticing an issue.
The 'subMenuItem' tabs on the sideBar are not dynamic. Notice the screenshot below. They are not hidden. I should be able to click on the 'Some Cool Stuff' tab and hide the sub menus. But this functionality isn't happening.

Has anyone else noticed this?

I'm assuming the necessary js files are in the shinydashboard package.













dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Some Cool Stuff", icon = icon("th")), 
        menuSubItem("Sub-item 1", tabName = "subitem1"),
        menuSubItem("Sub-item 2", tabName = "subitem2"),
      )
    ),


 dashboardBody(
    tabItems( 

#Tab Content
      tabItem("subitem1",
              "Sub-item 1 tab content"
      ),
      tabItem(tabName="forms", "subitem2",
              "Sub-item 2 tab content"
      ),

Winston thank you for that. It wasn't that I had an extra paren, but that I needed to move it down after the subMenuItems. So, subMenuItems need to be nested within the menuItem function.

Thanks so much.

Hoyt
